goal: The Kernel's built-in hard no-touch set protects only its own authority root (.imm/state, from kernel/storage_paths.ts); credential-type and CI/release patterns leave the built-in set, and any other protection is declared through docs/agents/no-touch.json or .imm/risk-floor.json (Spec docs/specs/kernel-owned-no-touch.spec.md D1-D5).

acceptance.assertion: Single-task delivery whose diff changes .env, nested/.env.local, cert.pem, private.key, nested/id_rsa.pub, id_ed25519, .npmrc, .netrc, .github/workflows/ci.yml or .changeset/config.json returns that path in changed_paths, and a force-added .imm/state/x still refuses with no_touch_path_changed naming it. Done looks like: taskDeliveryIdentity in tests/no-touch-paths.test.ts accepts each former default and throws only for .imm/state.

A batch Lane commit changing .github/workflows/ci.yml integrates and advances the Parent branch, while one changing .imm/state/x or a path declared in docs/agents/no-touch.json refuses with no_touch_path_changed and leaves the Parent ref unmoved. Done looks like: integrateLaneCommit in tests/no-touch-paths.test.ts and tests/batch-merge-queue.test.ts shows both outcomes.

imm-kernel intent validate reports valid for a scope_hint of .github/workflows/** or .env, and reports valid false with no_touch_path_changed for .imm/state/x, for the ancestor pair .imm plus .imm/state/x, and for a declared addition; a no-touch declaration carrying a remove field is rejected naming no_touch.remove. Done looks like: runKernelCommand output in tests/no-touch-paths.test.ts.

Loop guard G3 and repair validatePathsInScope allow .github/workflows/ci.yml and deploy.pem, and still block .imm/state/loop/state.json, docs/agents/no-touch.json and a declared no_touch_paths addition. Done looks like: evaluateGuards and validatePathsInScope verdicts in tests/loop-daemon-boundary.test.ts and tests/loop-daemon-repair.test.ts.
